title: 第一卷 第18章 二少的车，也不比我家大
content_zh:
雨下得有点大又密，起了一层白色的水雾。

    童喻问霍放，“二少是身体不舒服吗？”

    “我好得很。”霍放睨着她，“你来看病？”

    童喻摇头，“不是。来看个病人。”

    霍放没多问。

    “霍放。”

    童喻听到这个声音，回头看。

    是赵亦可。

    还有傅承言。

    傅承言依旧西装革履，来医院更像是视察工作，只是右手里拿着一把伞。

    赵亦可穿着牛油果绿的上衣，白色柔顺的长裤，头发披散在肩上，看起来清新又温柔。

    她站在傅承言身边，倒是一缕彩色的光。

    “咦，童喻，你也在啊。”赵亦可笑着跟童喻打招呼。

    童喻点了一下头。

    赵亦可没多问，只是望着霍放，“刚才跟院长聊了一下，他说会优先安排。”

    霍放表情淡淡，“嗯。”

    “那走吗？”赵亦可问霍放。

    她完全无视着傅承言。

    就跟无视童喻一样。

    霍放说：“你跟承言回去。”

    “那你呢？”

    “我送她。”霍放看了眼童喻。

    赵亦可眼神轻飘飘落在童喻身上，轻轻扬唇，“好。”

    她转身，便挽起了傅承言的胳膊，扬起脸，笑容甜美又娇俏，“承言，我们走吧。”

    傅承言低头看赵亦可的手，他没说什么，撑起了伞，举过她的头顶，和她一起下了台阶。

    “走不走？”霍放问童喻。

    童喻看着地面上被雨溅起来的水花，又看了眼霍放空空如也的双手。

    这会儿雨比刚才又大了。

    她把他的话还给他，“二少想当忧郁少年？”

    霍放轻哼，“我又不傻。”

    他转身。

    童喻看着他的背影，没走。

    霍放回头，“有地下停车场。”

    “……”童喻以为，他的车也停在地面的。

    。

    童喻坐在车里，手机一直震动。

    是潘蓉发的语音信息。

    句句都是60秒。

    童喻没有听，她不用听也知道潘蓉会说些什么。

    霍放瞥了她抓在手里的手机，“谁发的信息，怎么不回？”

    “不想回。”
content_en:
The rain was a bit heavy and dense, and there was a layer of white mist.

    Tong Yu asked Huo Fang, "Is the Second Young Master feeling unwell?"

    "I'm very fine." Huo Fang looked at her, "Are you coming to see a doctor?"

    Tong Yu shook his head, "No. Come see a patient."

    Huo Fang didn't ask any more questions.

    "Huo Fang."

    Tong Yu looked back when he heard the voice.

    It's Zhao Yike.

    And Fu Chengyan.

    Fu Chengyan was still wearing a suit and leather shoes, and coming to the hospital was more like inspecting work, but he was holding an umbrella in his right hand.

    Zhao Yike is wearing an avocado green top, white soft trousers, and her hair is spread over her shoulders. She looks fresh and gentle.

    She stood next to Fu Chengyan, a ray of colorful light.

    "Hey, Tong Yu, you're here too." Zhao Yike smiled and greeted Tong Yu.

    Tong Yu nodded.

    Zhao Yike didn't ask any more questions, just looked at Huo Fang, "I just had a chat with the dean, and he said he would prioritize it."

    Huo Fang said calmly, "Yeah."

    "Let's go then?" Zhao Yike asked Huo Fang.

    She completely ignored Fu Chengyan.

    It's like ignoring Tong Yu.

    Huo Fang said, "Go back with Chengyan."

    "What about you?"

    "I'll give it to her." Huo Fang glanced at Tong Yu.

    Zhao Yike's eyes fell lightly on Tong Yu, and he raised his lips gently, "Okay."

    She turned around, took Fu Chengyan's arm, raised her face, smiled sweetly and delicately, "Chengyan, let's go."

    Fu Chengyan lowered his head and looked at Zhao Yike's hand. Without saying anything, he held up the umbrella, raised it above her head, and walked down the steps with her.

    "Are you leaving?" Huo Fang asked Tong Yu.

    Tong Yu looked at the water splashed by the rain on the ground, and then looked at Huo Fang's empty hands.

    The rain is now heavier than before.

    She returned his words to him, "Second Young Master, do you want to be a melancholy boy?"

    Huo Fang hummed, "I'm not stupid."

    He turned around.

    Tong Yu looked at his back and didn't leave.

    Huo Fang turned around and said, "There is an underground parking lot."

    "..." Tong Yu thought that his car was also parked on the ground.

    .

    Tong Yu was sitting in the car, and her phone kept vibrating.

    It was a voice message sent by Pan Rong.

    Every sentence is 60 seconds.

    Tong Yu didn't listen. She knew what Pan Rong would say without having to listen.

    Huo Fang glanced at the mobile phone in her hand, "Who sent the message? Why didn't you reply?"

    "I don't want to go back."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 18 The second young master’s car is not bigger than mine.
